name: nfse-sdk-mcp
description: Local MCP tools for validating, generating, signing, and issuing Brazilian NFS-e DPS documents.

interface.longDescription: Use local NFS-e SDK tools to validate DPS JSON/XML, generate DPS XML, and optionally sign or transmit a note with an in-memory A1 certificate.
interface.defaultPrompt: Validate this DPS payload and generate XML if it is valid.
